info.description:
A- Listening: Upon completion of the course, students should be able to

- Listen to categorize information (U6)

- Listen to understand vocabulary from context (U8)

- Listen to lectures for similarities and differences (U5), for supporting statements (U5), for structure signals that connect ideas via a lecture (U7), and for note taking (U8), to understand cause and effect relationships (U6) and to interpret the speaker's attitude via a podcast (U9)

- Listen to a presentation for organization cues to distinguish facts and opinions (U4)

- Listen to a podcast and use prior knowledge to predict the content of a presentation (U7) - - Listen to a conversation for problems and (U10)

B- Speaking: Upon completion of the course, students should be able to

- Ask to clarify or confirm ideas to make sure they understand the ideas correctly (U6)

- Contribute additional information to a discussion (U7)

- Make repairs when making mistakes in speech (U8)

- Field questions during a discussion (U9)

- Describe unknown words (U10)

- Pronounce correctly weak forms of ‘that’ and ‘as’ ( U8)

- Know and use intonation patterns in questions and to express feelings and attitudes (U6, U7 and U10)

- Stress correctly to express the right meanings and to emphasize important information (U9)

- Discuss the result of an experiment, research findings and applications, and water issues (U6 and U7)

- Present the pros and cons of an invention; about a city, a plan for a public space, future problems and personal and community values. (U5, U7, U8, U9)
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of in-class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class

- Use their own laptops in class only for learning purposes

- Use CD-ROM provided with the textbook

- Access the course website (http://cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
